name: Gmail
description: Google Workspace email, contacts and labels.

objects.label: emails
objects.description: Messages in a mailbox, newest first.

fields.label: label
fields.description: A Gmail label such as Inbox, Starred, or one you made.

objects.label: contacts
objects.description: People in the address book, including contact groups.

fields.label: contact group
fields.description: A label on the contact, like Friends or Vendors.

objects.label: labels
objects.description: The mailbox's labels and how many messages each holds.

actions.label: an email
actions.description: Send mail. Choose whether each item becomes its own message.

params.label: to
params.description: An address, several addresses, or a piece that holds people.

actions.label: a draft
actions.description: Nothing is sent. A person reviews and sends by hand.

guidance: Gmail is reached through the Google Workspace API, normally as a service account with domain-wide delegation or as a specific mailbox owner. Sending to many people means one message per person; never put a whole list in To or Cc. Mailbox contents are sensitive: read only the labels or searches the plan names, and prefer a draft over a send when a person should review first.

setup.notes: Ask the Google Workspace administrator for API access to the mailbox this will run as. Automations run as that account, not as the person planning.
